items.a: Yes. Pathways is free practice for the U.S. citizenship test: civics, reading, writing, speaking and the N-400.

items.q: Is Pathways part of USCIS or the government?
items.a: No. Pathways is not affiliated with USCIS or the government. The civics questions and answers come from the official USCIS lists.

items.q: Can Pathways tell me how to answer the N-400 questions about me?
items.a: No. Pathways is not legal advice. We teach what each N-400 question means and how the officer may ask it. If yes might be true for you, talk to a lawyer first.
Amio is your AI tutor, not a real person. Amio explains in your language. You answer, read and write in English, like at the interview.
No. Your phone turns what you say into text. Only your scores are saved, never your voice or what you said.

items.q: Do I have to do the lessons in order?
items.a: No. You can open any topic and any lesson. The quick check only suggests where to start.

items.q: Can my class or program see my answers?
items.a: No. If you join a program with its code, it sees your name and counts, like lessons done. Never your answers or your questions to Amio.

items.q: How do I delete my data?
items.a: Go to Settings, then Delete all my data. It erases everything, on our side and on this phone.
